confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on Kerala-wide and Kochi price aggregates and one undated Munnar budget-guide snippet, with no Munnar-specific beer, cocktail or wine prices found. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local beer relationship (cocktail about 3x draft beer, wine glass about 2x beer) because direct evidence was weak. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Munnar's budget-to-mid-range tourist lodging; no booking pages or current listings were inspected. Rupee-to-USD conversions use an approximate rate of about 93 INR per USD. The FX observation (18 Nov 2026, 0.6720 USD per AUD) comes from search-result text summarising the RBA exchange rates page; the F11.1 table itself was not retrieved or verified, so the figure should be checked against the RBA daily table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Kerala-wide and Kochi aggregated beer and cappuccino prices, adjusted upward for Munnar's hill-station tourist pricing. Restaurant meal anchors are based on Munnar budget-guide ranges for local eateries and mid-range restaurants. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for Munnar's tea-estate and hill-town tourist market.
